business_problem: Supermetrics wanted to turn marketing reporting from a manual weekly task into an agentic workflow that could fix broken data connections, interpret campaign performance, and recommend next actions automatically.
solution_summary: Supermetrics uses Google Cloud to address this challenge: Supermetrics wanted to turn marketing reporting from a manual weekly task into an agentic workflow that could fix broken data connections, interpret campaign performance, and recommend next actions automatically. Agent Development Kit lets the team build modular functions that can be assembled into one marketing intelligence agent, serving as the orchestration layer. Vertex AI Agent Builder provides the runtime and tooling for the agent that automates reporting and error handling, serving as the serving layer. Imagen supports the generation of new creative options suggested by the marketing agent, serving as the compute layer. Marketing data connections feed the agent, ADK modules handle error detection and workflow logic, Vertex AI Agent Builder serves the live reporting assistant, and the system can analyze performance in real time and even suggest new creative assets through Imagen.
